statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and dizziness
The symptoms are clinically consistent with underlying nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) was ordered
The service was ordered for continuous ambulatory assessment to evaluate correlation between symptoms and potential arrhythmic events
The diagnoses supporting the service are I34.0, R00.2, and R42
The claim was denied based on Reason Code CO-197
The denial reason is that required precertification or prior authorization was not obtained before services were rendered
